thread:
Noor: quick pulse  we need three tight competitive claims for next week's launch (blog + webinar + battlecard). audience: infra/platform buyers, SEs. keep them headline-short.

Caleb: recommend pillars: predictable unit economics, dependable tail latency (with fallbacks), one runtime across hosted/dedicated/private. each claim 1 line + 2 rapid rebut bullets.

Mei: agree. marketing AB test ideas: "Predictable costs, fewer surprises" vs "One API from prototype to SLA". Subheads should show outcome: budget certainty, lower ops lift.

Jonas: benchmark note: show p50/p95/p99 + cost per 1M tokens. add a tiny methodology line. avoid absolute words like "always" or "cheapest".

Hana: legal flagged superlatives. use comparative phrases: "lower unit cost in common production patterns". Ops wants a single-fallback slide: quantized model -> region reroute -> queued burst handling.

Caleb: quick rebut snippets for sales: 
- "We run our own infra": "Keep control but offload the daily ops and stabilize per-request economics." 
- "API simplicity is fine": "We keep the simple API while adding production observability and private placements." 
- "Cloud global regions": "We route by region and provide dedicated placements to meet locality & compliance."

Mei: two promo one-liners: 
- "Ship reliable LLM features without overprovisioning GPUs." 
- "Same API, predictable price and SLA-ready latency."

Jonas: slide blurb: `Method: 10k anonymized prompts (median 115 tokens). Measured p50/p95/p99 latency and normalized token cost. Compared hosted endpoints and tuned dedicated instance.`

Noor: action items: Noor  draft 2 headline variants + 90s webinar opener (today); Caleb  run 48h SE poll + gather 3 real rebut examples; Mei  finalize promo copy (EOD); Jonas  mock chart + fallback slide (tomorrow); Hana  legal-safe language + review (tomorrow).

ops-bot: created doc: https://notion.redwood/competitive/launch-pulse-v1 (v1) :white_check_mark:

Caleb: I'll ping with poll results. drop any short customer quotes that back the econ claim here. :thumbsup:

Mei: adding a beta quote: "Moving to Redwood Dedicated let us forecast inference spend for the quarter."

Noor: nice. keep the copy testable and avoid absolutes. we'll iterate after Caleb's poll and Jonas' chart. :rocket:
